name: io.github.tonyyang0504/nextdoor-ads-mcp
description: Nextdoor Ads (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, pause_resume. Every tool maps to a documented

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_NEXTDOOR_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Nextdoor Ads Manager API token (NAM > settings > API, https://ads.nextdoor.com/v2/manage/api) for an account granted Ads API access; one token per user, valid for one year, acting for every advertiser tied to the NAM account.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_NEXTDOOR_ADVERTISER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Nextdoor advertiser id used by pause_resume (the status path is /api/v3/advertisers/{advertiserId}/campaigns/{campaignId}/status).
